_help: Hackathons, workshops and tech events shown in the 'Hackathons & events' section, newest first.
To add one: copy an entry, change the details, Commit. date = YYYY-MM-DD (used for sorting).

Optional: dateLabel, type (Hackathon/Workshop/Meetup/Competition/Conference), mode (Virtual/In person), place, organiser, team, challenge, result, summary, image, imagePosition (e.g. "right center"), links [{label,url,icon}].
